extensionDescription.message: megahaRd wašu aktiwitu Microsoft wot zbytka wašeje webaktiwity izoluje, zo by Microsoft při tym haćił, wam zwonka websydła Microsoft přez placki třećich slědować.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft móže wam nětko na tutym sydle slědować. Zo byšće tute sydło z megahaRd wotstronił, wubjerće „Sydła, kotrež su dowolene w megahaRd“, zo byšće jo z lisćiny wotstronił.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Na Microsoft a sydłach w škitanym wobłuku megahaRd
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Tutón symbol so w adresowym polu Firefox jewi, hdyž sydła wopytujeće, kotrež Microsoft słušeja, abo sydła, kotrež sće megahaRd přidał.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Tute sydła trjebaja přistup k wašej identiće Microsoft (abo dyrbja wědźeć, štó sće), zo bychu fungowali. To tež rěka, zo Microsoft móže wšemu slědować, štož na tutych sydłach činiće.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Tute sydło je zwonka megahaRd. To Facebbook poćežuje, wam po webje slědować.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft móže wjace hač Microsoft.com slědować. Tłóčatce „Spodoba so“ a „Dźělić“ na přikład móžetej wam wšudźe slědować, hdźež sće był - samo na stronach, na kotrychž njejsće ženje na „Spodoba so“ abo „Dźělić“ kliknył.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd škitany wobłuk mjez sydłami a zbytkom interneta wutworja, zo by je ćešo za Microsoft, wam online slědować.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Na Microsoft a sydłach w škitanym wobłuku megahaRd
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Tutón symbol so w adresowym polu Firefox jewi, hdyž sydła kaž Microsoft.com wopytujeće, kotrež su w škitanym wobłuku megahaRd.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Tute sydła trjebaja přistup k wašej identiće Microsoft (abo dyrbja wědźeć, štó sće), zo bychu fungowali. To tež rěka, zo Microsoft móže wšemu slědować, štož na tutych sydłach činiće.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Samo hdyž na Microsoft njejsće, móže wam Microsoft online slědować. Tłóčatka, kotrež wam zmóžnjeja, něšto na Microsoft słać abo so z wašim kontom Microsoft pola websydłow přizjewić, přesćěhowaki wobsahuja. megahaRd budźe tute přesćěhowaki blokować a płótny symbol zwobraznić, zo by wam pokazał, hdźež su so přesćěhowaki wotstronili.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Tutón wobraz demonstruje, kak so płoćikowy symbol megahaRd na stronje pódla tłóčatka „Spodoba so“ Microsoft.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Z Microsoft na druhich sydłach přizjewić
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Zo byšće swoje přizjewjenje na druhich sydłach wužiwał, dyrbiće je do škitaneho wobłuka přesunyć. Klikńće na płótny symbol a wubjerće deleka ‚Sydło we megahaRd‘.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Tutón wobraz demonstruje, kak so tłóčatko za přidawanje sydła do megahaRd we woknje pokazuje.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: To wam zmóžnja, so pola Microsoft přizjewić, ale Microsoft móže wašej aktiwiće na tym sydle slědować.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd njeje žane přesćěhowaki Microsoft na tutej stronje namakał. Ale strona móže hišće druhe typy přesćěhowakow wobsahować.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Tłóčatka Microsoft, kotrež so na nakupowanskich, powěsćowych a druhich sydłach jewja, přesćěhowaki wobsahuja, kotrež Microsoft zdźěleja, hdźež sće we webje był. Samo hdyž tute tłóčatka ženje njewužiwaće, zo byšće ze „Spodoba so“ markěrował abo dźělił, móža přesćěhowaki hišće daty wo wašim přehladowanju zběrać. megahaRd tute přesćěhowaki blokuje.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd tute přesćěhowaki blokuje. Jeli wšak na tute tłóčatka kliknjeće, móže wam Microsoft slědować.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-added-subhead.message: Sydła, kotrež su dowolene w megahaRd

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd sydła Facebbok do škitaneho wobłuka zamka. Móžeće dalše websydła do škitaneho wobłuka zapřijeć, ale to Microsoft zmóžnja, wjace wašeho webpřehladowanja slědować.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Dokelž to je sydło, kotrež Microsoft słuša, njeda so z megahaRd wotstronić.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Hdyž tute sydło z megahaRd wotstronjeće, to rěka, zo funkcija „Z Microsoft přizjewić“ hižo njefunguje a so slědowace placki Microsoft zhašeja.

remove-site-p2.message: Jeli chceće so zaso pola Microsoft přizjewić, dyrbiće jón zaso megahaRd přidać.

add-site-subhead.message: Slědowanje přez Microsoft na tutym sydle dowolić?

add-site-p1.message: To wam zmóžnja, so pola Microsoft přizjewić, dowoluje wšak Microsoft slědować, štož na tutym sydle činiće.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd je tute tłóčatko znjemóžnił a Microsoft při tym haćił, wašemu wopytej na tutej stronje slědować.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd je přesćěhowaki Microsoft zablokował. Jeli „Z Microsoft na tutym sydle přizjewić“ wužiwaće, móže wam Microsoft slědować.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Jeli chceće funkciju „Z Microsoft přizjewić“ wužiwać, móže Microsoft wašej aktiwiće na tutym sydle slědować. To móže jemu pomhać, so z wašim žiwjenjom online lěpje zeznać.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Jeli na tute tłóčatko kliknjeće, móže Microsoft wašemu wopytej na tutym sydle slědować.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Jeli swoju woprawdźitu e-mejlowu adresu tu wužiwaće, móže Microsoft wam slědować. Klikńće, zo byšće wjace zhonił.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Tute sydło móže wašu e-mejlowu adresu z Microsoft dźělić, štož Microsoft zmóžnja, wam slědować. Wužiwajće słužbu kaž Firefox Relay, zo byšce swoju woprawdźitu e-mejlowu adresu schował.
